patch_description: This edit upgrades the candidate ansatz by untying the parameters of the post-CZ `RZ` rotations (which were erroneously reusing the `rz_pre` parameters) and adding a final `RX` layer to each block, as recommended. Furthermore, it updates the linear `CZ` chain to a symmetric `CZ` ring topology (from Generation 3). The combination of dense single-qubit rotations (RY, RZpre, RZpost, RX) with a well-connected two-qubit entanglement ring increases the overall expressivity of the ansatz block, helping to stably reach higher accuracy boundaries more efficiently.
